svg.title: For its diagonal entry use P i,k Qik,ik = 2Na + Ra; its off-diagonal entry is Pab. This is exactly (FM6), already shown conserved. The last sample is nonzero on it, so the generator is nonzero. Every conserved centered real signed tensor in this weight-four space is its real scalar multiple. Any later nonzero scalar normalization, including either sign, preserves the rank and the conserved- line statements; the normalization of shell fluxes is a separate argument. There is a raw degree-five vector direction which must be kept until the equation quotient is taken. In polynomial notation its components are
